name: Fish and Chips
instructions: Soak potato fries in cold water 30 minutes. Drain and dry thoroughly.
Heat oil to 325°F. Fry potatoes 5-6 minutes until cooked but not browned. Drain.
Increase oil to 375°F. Fry potatoes again 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy. Season with salt.
Whisk flour, baking powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Whisk in cold beer until smooth.
Pat fish dry. Dip in batter and let excess drip off.
Fry fish 4-5 minutes until deep golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
Serve immediately with fries, malt vinegar or tartar sauce.

substitutions.gluten_free: Use rice flour and gluten-free sparkling water for the batter.

notes: Double-frying the chips is what makes them crispy. Do not skip the first fry.
